race.title: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
race.verdict: MR FREEDOM looks ready to strike off his reduced mark given how he shaped at Goodwood last time. Pyleates is next best having had excuses at Salisbury. MR FREEDOM PYLEATES MUST BELIEVE
race.bettingForecast: Charging Thunder (15/8), Mr Freedom (3/1), Must Believe (9/2), Enziya (5/1), Pyleates (8/1), Belle Of Kt (14/1)
